R750.note: Switches to array-form exec (no shell tokenization) and adds a hostname/IPv6 allowlist regex that covers real hostnames, so no legitimate host is rejected.

R751.note: crypto.randomBytes(16) replaces Math.random(); no other behaviour changed.

R752.note: SecureRandom-derived 128-bit token replaces Random().nextFloat(); cookie/session comparison logic unaffected.

R753.note: Imports org.owasp.html.Encode, but that class does not exist in the OWASP HTML Sanitizer package (org.owasp.html has PolicyFactory/Sanitizers, not Encode); the real forHtml() static method lives in org.owasp.encoder.Encode - this will not compile.

R754.note: GET now renders a CSRF-token confirmation form instead of deleting directly, POST does the deletion under doubleCsrfProtection; this behaviour change is the required fix for a state-changing GET and is stated plainly.

R755.note: Allowlist dispatch table correctly closes the code-injection vector, but it eliminates the endpoint's entire prior capability (arbitrary transformation scripts) - a real restriction on legitimate use, openly stated but not merely incidental hardening.

R756.note: Parameterized query with ? placeholder; matches the stated contract exactly, no other behaviour change.

R757.note: Rejecting CR/LF fully closes the Redis inline-protocol injection, but it also throws an uncaught ArgumentException (500) for any legitimate multi-line annotation text, which the original endpoint accepted; not disclosed as a functional trade-off in the write-up beyond the mechanics.

R758.note: weak_ptr storage + lock()-at-use-site matches the stated contract (live observers called in order, expired ones skipped); both files updated consistently.

R759.note: Magic-byte MIME detection plus allowlist and random server-side filename is the standard fix; restricting to image types is what CWE-434 remediation requires, not extraneous.

R760.note: Lambda move-captures a std::unique_ptr and is passed to std::function<void()>, which requires the target to be CopyConstructible - a lambda with a move-only capture is not copyable, so this fails to compile (classic move-only-lambda-into-std::function error); should have captured a shared_ptr instead.

R761.note: HttpUtility.HtmlEncode() applied to the untrusted value before output; no other change.

R762.note: Adds magic-byte format detection and derives extension from detected format instead of client Content-Type; legitimate PNG/JPEG/GIF uploads still pass.

R763.note: JSON-serializes Model.Label and drops the surrounding literal quotes in the template so the JSON's own quoting is used; Title encoding and RefreshSeconds numeric type are both preserved per the stated contract.
